name: idc-duke-breast-cancer-mri
description: Dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance images of breast cancer patients with tumor locations (Duke-Breast-Cancer-MRI). Please see the Duke-Breast-Cancer-MRI wiki page to learn more about the images and to obtain the supporting metadata for this collection.

recordSet.name: Clinical variables with measured completeness
recordSet.description: Completeness is measured from the source repository's own records. A field populated entirely with non-answers is reported as populated but not informative, because it blocks an analysis just as surely as an absent field.
